title: Databases without successful backups using NOT EXISTS
description: Use NOT EXISTS to return databases for which no backup with status = success exists. Failed/cancelled backups are not successful. Return exactly one column: database_name. Sort by database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT d.name AS database_name
FROM databases AS d
hints: Correlate the subquery with the current d.id.
NOT EXISTS checks that no matching successful row exists.
solution_explanation: A correlated NOT EXISTS directly expresses “no successful backup exists”.
